QUOTE: The library creates no threads. The four spawn sites the index found are all in `programs/`... `programs/ssl/ssl_pthread_server.c:277` (`pthread_create`) | one thread per TLS connection | refuses to build unless `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` are set (line 24)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads and that the pthread example refuses to build without threading enabled. It lists `ssl_pthread_server.c` as one of four spawn sites and never says it compiles to a stub main, and it does not say a default build creates no threads at all.
